name: empathix
description: Empathix demo — FRONT (Next.js) + BACK (Express). Run both with one command.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix BACK install && npm --prefix FRONT install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACK,FRONT -c yellow,blue "npm --prefix BACK run dev" "npm --prefix FRONT run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix BACK run compile && npm --prefix FRONT run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n BACK,FRONT -c yellow,blue "npm --prefix BACK start" "npm --prefix FRONT start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix BACK run typecheck && npm --prefix FRONT run typecheck
